_about: Languages the app can teach. 'code' is the key used for translations in every other data file. 'tts' is the BCP-47 tag used for browser speech fallback when no recording exists. 'specialChars' builds the on-screen helper keyboard for typing exercises. 'letters' is the alphabet (single characters, without tone marks) used by letter games such as Hangman; digraphs like 'gb' or 'ch' are played as their separate letters.
